Hi Clare — welcome and congrats on the signup. I'm Sergio on the PLG onboarding team, happy to help triage this. A couple quick clarifying q's so I can route properly:

- Is the evaluation limited to a single developer/team or do you expect multiple users to run tests?
- Approximate token volume per test (you mentioned 10k samples — is that 10k tokens per sample or 10k tokens total)?
- Any compliance constraints (e.g., customer data, audio PII) we should note for a Private/Dedicated conversation?

Our standard starter grant is a 10k-token sandbox; for heavier validation we can provision a one-off 30k promo credit if you share a bit more detail. If this looks like a demo-to-procurement path, Marissa (cc'd) can also loop in options for extended trials.

If you prefer, we can schedule a 20–30 min quick call — I can provision credits right after approval.
